2609.18487.title: ActionPiece: Rethinking Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
2609.18487.paper_summary: Action tokenizers play a central role in autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models, determining both the targets for policy training and the executable commands recovered from predicted tokens. Their fidelity is commonly evaluated using pointwise reconstruction metrics such as mean squared error (MSE), yet small individual errors do not fully characterize how faithfully action adjustments across demonstrations are preserved. After compression, similar actions may still cluster around a representative motion, while the adjustments needed for different contexts are diminished, distorted, or even reversed. We introduce physical rank consistency (PRC) to measure how well tokenization preserves local physical distance rankings after reconstruction. Evaluating decoded actions provides a common reference across token vocabularies and decoder architectures, complementing pointwise accuracy with a measure of relational fidelity. We further present ActionPiece, which preserves physical action relationships through joint supervision of representation learning and quantization. Physical rank preservation supervises near-far ordering in encoder and quantized feature distances, while quantization regularization applies the same ordering to codeword assignment distributions. Both objectives augment reconstruction, producing discrete action tokens for standard autoregressive policy learning and execution through a frozen decoder. Under the same Qwen3-VL-4B policy training setup, ActionPiece achieves 94.8% on LIBERO and 68.8% on unseen LIBERO-Plus, with additional evaluations reaching 71.9% on SimplerEnv and 51.5% across VLA-Arena L0-L2. Component ablations show that the two objectives jointly improve PRC and policy success, demonstrating the value of physical relationship supervision for action tokenization.
2609.18487.paper_summary_zh: 行動標記器在自回歸視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型中扮演著核心角色，決定了政策訓練的目標以及從預測標記中恢復的可執行命令。它們的準確性通常使用逐點重建指標來評估，例如均方誤差（MSE），然而小的個別誤差並不能完全描述在演示過程中行動調整的忠實保留程度。經過壓縮後，相似的行動仍可能圍繞一個代表性動作聚集，而不同情境所需的調整則可能減少、扭曲或甚至反轉。我們引入物理秩一致性（PRC）來測量標記化在重建後保留局部物理距離排名的效果。評估解碼的行動提供了一個跨標記詞彙和解碼器架構的共同參考，通過關聯忠實度的測量來補充逐點準確性。我們進一步提出了ActionPiece，通過對表示學習和量化的聯合監督來保留物理行動關係。物理秩保持監督編碼器和量化特徵距離中的近遠排序，而量化正則化則將相同的排序應用於代碼字分配分佈。這兩個目標增強了重建，產生了離散的行動標記，以便通過凍結的解碼器進行標準的自回歸政策學習和執行。在相同的Qwen3-VL-4B政策訓練設置下，ActionPiece在LIBERO上達到94.8%，在未見過的LIBERO-Plus上達到68.8%，額外評估在SimplerEnv上達到71.9%，在VLA-Arena L0-L2上達到51.5%。組件消融實驗顯示這兩個目標共同改善了PRC和政策成功，證明了物理關係監督對行動標記化的價值。
